title: Acquisitive Podcast Ep 08
description:
Episode 08: Brian Amann

CPA and Accounting Firms are HOT right now. With firm owners retiring, new emerging technology, lower numbers of accounting students in the US and growing off-shore teams, the accounting industry is in a major state of change. An accounting firm operations expert like Brian Amann could be the difference between buying and building a successful modern firm or failure.
